name: Aurora Lyrics
description: Beautiful full-screen synced lyrics that light up word by word (karaoke style) from Apple Music, Musixmatch, NetEase, Spotify and LRCLIB. 7 layouts, 12 themes, 10 motions and 11 word animations, translation, mini floating lyrics, shareable lyric images, Songsterr guitar tabs and a live lyrics card in the Now Playing panel.
